from studio.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from studio.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from studio.common.base import Main
from studio.inputs import BoolInput
from studio.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from studio.schema.content_block import ContentBlock
from studio.schema.content_types import TextContent
from studio.schema.image import Image
from studio.schema.message import Message
from studio.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)
from studio.utils.file_deliverables import FileDeliverablesManager
from studio.utils.file_types import ATTACHMENT_ONLY_FILE_TYPES
from studio.utils.flow_utils import FlowUtility

INCOMING_FILE_PATHS_KEY = "incoming_file_paths"


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="conversation_history",
            display_name="Conversation History",
            value="",
            info="History to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES + ATTACHMENT_ONLY_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message. Supports: PDF, DOCX, Excel, PPTX, images, and text files.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="background_color",
            display_name="Background Color",
            info="The background color of the icon.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="chat_icon",
            display_name="Icon",
            info="The icon of the message.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="text_color",
            display_name="Text Color",
            info="The text color of the name",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
        Output(
            display_name="Conversation History",
            name="history",
            method="conversation_history_response",
        ),
    ]

    async def conversation_history_response(self) -> Message:
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatInput.conversation_history_response] ENTRY | self.files=%s | file_count=%s",
            type(self.files).__name__,
            len(self.files) if self.files else 0,
        )

        if not self.files or len(self.files) == 0:
            message = Message(
                text=self.conversation_history,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )
        else:
            message = await Message.create(
                text=self.conversation_history,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )

        self.history.value = message
        self.status = message
        return message

    @staticmethod
    def _file_name(file: str | Image) -> str:
        """Returns the clean original file name for an uploaded file path or Image"""
        path_str = file.path if isinstance(file, Image) else file
        if not path_str:
            Main.logger().debug("[ChatInput._file_name] path_str is None")
            return ""
        return FileDeliverablesManager.extract_original_file_name(path_str)

    def _attached_files_block(self) -> ContentBlock | None:
        """Builds a display-only content block listing uploaded file names when skills are active.

        The block is rendered separately from the user's typed message so the file
        metadata stays out of the chat bubble, while Message.to_lc_message folds it
        back into agent memory so the coworker retains the file names across turns.
        """
        if not self.files:
            Main.logger().debug("[ChatInput._attached_files_block] No files to process")
            return None
        if not self._skill_component_present():
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatInput._attached_files_block] No skill component present"
            )
            return None
        names = [
            name for name in (ChatInput._file_name(file) for file in self.files) if name
        ]
        if not names:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatInput._attached_files_block] No valid file names found"
            )
            return None
        return ContentBlock(
            title=Message.ATTACHED_FILES_BLOCK_TITLE,
            contents=[TextContent(text=name) for name in names],
        )

    def _skill_component_present(self) -> bool:
        """Returns True when the graph contains a SkillComponent (agentic-flow skill or coworker filesystem)"""
        try:
            nodes = self.graph.raw_graph_data.get("nodes", [])
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatInput._skill_component_present] graph.raw_graph_data unavailable"
            )
            return False
        return FlowUtility.nodes_have_component_type(
            nodes, FlowUtility.SKILL_COMPONENT_TYPE
        )

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatInput.message_response] ENTRY | self.files=%s | file_count=%s | files_repr=%s",
            type(self.files).__name__,
            len(self.files) if self.files else 0,
            repr(self.files)[:200] if self.files else "None/empty",
        )

        if not self.files or len(self.files) == 0:
            message = Message(
                text=self.input_value,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )
        else:
            message = await Message.create(
                text=self.input_value,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )

        files_block = self._attached_files_block()
        if files_block:
            message.content_blocks = [*message.content_blocks, files_block]

        if (
            self.files
            and hasattr(self, "graph")
            and self.graph
            and hasattr(self.graph, "ctx")
        ):
            paths = [f for f in self.files if isinstance(f, str)]
            if paths:
                existing = list(self.graph.ctx.channel.incoming_file_paths)
                self.graph.ctx.channel.incoming_file_paths = existing + paths
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatInput] Stored %s incoming file path(s) in graph.ctx | paths=%s",
                    len(paths),
                    paths,
                )
            else:
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatInput] self.files present but no str paths | types=%s",
                    [type(f).__name__ for f in self.files],
                )
        else:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatInput] No files to store | self.files=%s | has_graph=%s",
                bool(self.files),
                hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph is not None,
            )

        if (
            self.session_id
            and isinstance(message, Message)
            and self.should_store_message
        ):
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

    outputs: ClassVar[list] = [

    _CHANNEL_DELIVERY_FIELDS: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(

    def _gateway_base_url(self) -> str:
        """Return the full gateway base URL including API prefix."""
        return (
            (get_config().channel_gateway_api_url or "")
            + ChatOutput.CHANNEL_GATEWAY_REST_API_PREFIX
        )

    def _get_agent_id(self) -> str:
        """Resolve agent_id from graph flow_id."""
        try:
            flow_id = self.graph.flow_id
        except AttributeError as exc:
            raise ValueError("graph flow_id not found") from exc
        return str(flow_id)

    def _get_agent_session_id(self) -> str:
        """Resolve the agent session id from the typed graph context."""
        agent_session_id = self.graph.ctx.session.agent_session_id
        if not agent_session_id:
            raise KeyError("agent_session_id not found in graph context")
        return str(agent_session_id)

    def _set_llm_fields_visibility(self, build_config: dotdict, visible: bool) -> None:
        """Show or hide shared LLM inputs when channel delivery is toggled."""
        for name in ChatOutput._LLM_FIELD_NAMES:
            if name in build_config:
                build_config[name]["show"] = visible

    async def _auto_populate_routes(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch all routes for this agent and auto-populate selected_routes and delivery_targets schema."""
        agent_id = self._get_agent_id()
        if not agent_id:
            return
        try:
            routes = await self._fetch_and_filter_routes(build_config, agent_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            Main.logger().warning(
                f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Failed | agent_id={agent_id} | error={exc}"
            )
            raise

    async def _fetch_and_filter_routes(
        self, build_config: dotdict, agent_id: str
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Fetch routes, filter by access, and populate build config."""
        base_url = self._gateway_base_url()
        routes = await fetch_agent_routes(base_url, agent_id)
        raw_route_summary = [
            f"{r.get('channel_name', '?')}({r.get('channel_type', '?')}/{r.get('route_type', '?')})"
            for r in routes
        ]
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Raw routes | agent_id={agent_id} | {raw_route_summary}"
        )
        user_id = str(self._user_id) if self._user_id else None
        workspace_id = (
            build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value", "") or self.workspace_id
        )
        if user_id and workspace_id:
            try:
                routes = await filter_routes_by_user_access(
                    routes=routes,
                    flow_id=agent_id,
                    user_id=user_id,
                    workspace_id=workspace_id,
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                Main.logger().warning(
                    f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] User access filter failed | error={exc}"
                )
                raise
        display_options = [
            f"{r['channel_name']} | {r['channel_type']} | {r['route_type']} | {r['route_id']}"
            f" | {r.get('description', '')} | {r.get('purpose', '')}"
            for r in routes
            if r.get("channel_type") not in ChatOutput.EXCLUDED_CHANNEL_TYPES
        ]
        build_config[ChatOutput.ATTR_SELECTED_ROUTES]["options"] = display_options
        build_config[ChatOutput.ATTR_SELECTED_ROUTES]["value"] = display_options
        await update_delivery_targets_schema(
            build_config=build_config,
            routes=routes,
            delivery_targets=self.delivery_targets or [],
            delivery_targets_key=ChatOutput.ATTR_DELIVERY_TARGETS,
            excluded_channel_types=ChatOutput.EXCLUDED_CHANNEL_TYPES,
            gateway_base_url=base_url,
        )
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Done | agent_id={agent_id} | count={len(display_options)}"
        )
        return routes

    def _get_user_query(self) -> str:
        """Resolve the user query, preferring the inbound channel message.

        Falls back to the upstream ChatInput value from the graph (e.g.
        playground/no-channel runs) when no inbound original_message is
        present, so the delivery resolver still receives the user's intent
        instead of an empty query.
        """
        inbound_ctx = self._get_inbound_channel_context()
        original_message = str(inbound_ctx.get("original_message", "") or "")
        if original_message:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._get_user_query] source=inbound | query=%s",
                original_message[:120],
            )
            return original_message
        fallback = self._chat_input_value()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._get_user_query] source=chat_input | query=%s",
            fallback[:120],
        )
        return fallback

    def _get_inbound_channel_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the inbound channel context dict, or empty when absent."""
        try:
            inbound_ctx = self.graph.ctx.channel.inbound_channel_context
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return {}
        return inbound_ctx or {}

    def _chat_input_value(self) -> str:
        """Read the user input from the upstream ChatInput vertex params."""
        try:
            vertices = self.graph.vertices
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._chat_input_value] graph.vertices unavailable"
            )
            return ""
        for vertex in vertices:
            if ChatOutput._CHAT_INPUT_COMPONENT_NAME not in vertex.id:
                continue
            value = vertex.params.get("input_value", "")
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._chat_input_value] vertex=%s | input_value=%s",
                vertex.id,
                str(value)[:120],
            )
            if value:
                return str(value)
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _derive_routes_from_targets(delivery_targets: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
        """Build selected_routes from delivery_targets rows at runtime."""
        seen: set[str] = set()
        routes: list[str] = []
        for row in delivery_targets:
            channel_str = row.get("channel", "").strip()
            if channel_str and channel_str not in seen:
                seen.add(channel_str)
                routes.append(channel_str)
        return routes

    def _input_to_text(self) -> str:
        """Convert the HandleInput input_value to a plain string."""
        value = self.input_value
        if value is None:
            return ""
        try:
            return value.get_text() or ""
        except AttributeError:
            return str(value)

    async def _store_chat_message(self, text: str) -> Message:
        """Build and optionally persist the chat message for display."""
        source, icon, display_name, source_id = (
            self.get_properties_from_source_component()
        )
        if self.chat_icon:
            icon = self.chat_icon
        if type(self.input_value) is Message:
            message = self.input_value
            message.text = text
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        message.session_id = self.session_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id
        message.properties.source = Source(
            id=source_id or None, display_name=display_name or None
        )
        message.properties.icon = icon
        message.properties.background_color = self.background_color
        message.properties.text_color = self.text_color
        message.properties.state = "complete"
        message.properties.allow_markdown = False
        message.properties.edited = False
        if self.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            message = await self.send_message(message)
        self.status = message
        return message

    async def _run_channel_delivery(self, bot_text: str) -> None:
        """Delegate delivery to ProcessChannelDelivery with injected LLM config."""
        config = get_config()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] START | ff_file_url_strategy=%s | attach_incoming_files=%s",
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
            self.attach_incoming_files,
        )
        message_refs = self._collect_message_file_refs()
        incoming_refs: list[dict] = []
        if self.attach_incoming_files:
            incoming_refs = self._collect_incoming_file_refs()
        deliverable_refs = self._collect_deliverable_file_refs()
        file_refs = message_refs + incoming_refs + deliverable_refs
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] file_refs collected | message=%s | incoming=%s | deliverable=%s | total=%s",
            len(message_refs),
            len(incoming_refs),
            len(deliverable_refs),
            len(file_refs),
        )
        if file_refs:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] file_refs[0] keys=%s | sample=%s",
                list(file_refs[0].keys()),
                {k: str(v)[:80] for k, v in file_refs[0].items() if k != "content"},
            )

        llm, _display_name = await self.build_llm()
        resolver = DeliveryLLMResolver(llm)
        processor = ProcessChannelDelivery(resolver)
        gateway_base_url = self._gateway_base_url()
        gateway_client = GatewayClientAdapter(gateway_base_url)

        _raw = self.delivery_targets
        delivery_targets = (
            _raw.to_dict("records") if hasattr(_raw, "to_dict") else (_raw or [])
        )
        inbound_context = self._extract_inbound_context()
        request = DeliveryRequest(
            agent_activity_trace=self._agent_activity_trace_payload(),
            agent_session_id=self._get_agent_session_id(),
            bot_response=bot_text,
            delivery_targets=delivery_targets,
            file_attachments=file_refs,
            gateway_base_url=gateway_base_url,
            inbound_context=inbound_context,
            user_query=self._get_user_query(),
        )
        results = await processor.process(request, gateway_client)
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] Done | results=%s | successes=%s",
            len(results),
            sum(1 for r in results if r.success),
        )

    def _extract_inbound_context(self) -> InboundChannelContext:
        """Extract inbound channel context from graph for LLM awareness."""
        try:
            typed_ctx = self.graph.ctx
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._extract_inbound_context] graph context unavailable",
            )
            return InboundChannelContext()
        inbound_ctx = typed_ctx.channel.inbound_channel_context or {}
        external_user = typed_ctx.user.external_user_name or ""
        incoming_route = typed_ctx.channel.incoming_route_type or ""
        incoming_user_name = str(inbound_ctx.get("sender_name", "") or "") or str(
            external_user
        )
        channel_type = str(inbound_ctx.get("channel_type", "") or "")
        route_type = str(inbound_ctx.get("route_type", "") or "") or str(incoming_route)
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._extract_inbound_context] external_user_name=%s | inbound_ctx_keys=%s",
            external_user,
            list(inbound_ctx.keys()) if inbound_ctx else "empty",
        )
        return InboundChannelContext(
            channel_type=channel_type,
            incoming_user_name=incoming_user_name,
            original_message=str(inbound_ctx.get("original_message", "") or "")[:500],
            route_type=route_type,
            show_agent_activity_card=ChannelAgentActivitySetup.is_enabled(inbound_ctx),
        )

    def _agent_activity_trace_payload(self) -> dict[str, object] | None:
        """Serialize the Teams agent-activity accumulator from typed channel context."""
        try:
            typed_ctx = self.graph.ctx
        except (AttributeError, TypeError) as exc:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._agent_activity_trace_payload] graph.ctx unavailable | %s",
                exc,
            )
            return None
        accumulator = typed_ctx.channel.agent_activity_trace
        if not isinstance(accumulator, AgentActivityTraceAccumulator):
            return None
        trace = accumulator.trace()
        if not trace.has_activity():
            return None
        return trace.to_serializable()

    def _collect_message_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Extract file references from the input Message, if present."""
        refs: list[dict] = []
        if type(self.input_value) is not Message:
            return refs
        if not self.input_value.files:
            return refs
        config = get_config()
        for f in self.input_value.files:
            if type(f) is not str:
                continue
            if config.ff_file_url_strategy == FileUrlStrategy.S3_KEY:
                original_name = extract_original_file_name(f)
                s3_ref = resolve_incoming_file_s3_reference(f)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": f,
                        **s3_ref.model_dump(),
                    }
                )
            else:
                original_name = extract_original_file_name(f)
                url = resolve_incoming_file_url(f)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": f,
                        "url": url,
                    }
                )
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._collect_message_file_refs] → %s file_ref(s) | raw_count=%s | strategy=%s",
            len(refs),
            len(self.input_value.files),
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
        )
        return refs

    def _collect_incoming_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Collect file refs from incoming channel files stored in graph context."""
        refs: list[dict] = []
        try:
            incoming = self.graph.ctx.channel.incoming_file_paths
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return refs
        config = get_config()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] paths=%s | strategy=%s",
            len(incoming),
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
        )
        for p in incoming:
            original_name = extract_original_file_name(p)
            if config.ff_file_url_strategy == FileUrlStrategy.S3_KEY:
                s3_ref = resolve_incoming_file_s3_reference(p)
                ref_dict = {
                    "file_name": original_name,
                    "file_path": p,
                    **s3_ref.model_dump(),
                }
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] S3_KEY | name=%s | s3_bucket=%s | s3_key=%s",
                    original_name,
                    s3_ref.s3_bucket,
                    s3_ref.s3_key[:60],
                )
                refs.append(ref_dict)
            else:
                url = resolve_incoming_file_url(p)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": p,
                        "url": url,
                    }
                )
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] URL | name=%s | url=%s",
                    original_name,
                    url[:80] if url else "(empty)",
                )
        return refs

    def _collect_deliverable_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Collect file deliverables from the typed graph context."""
        try:
            deliverables = list(self.graph.ctx.channel.file_deliverables)
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return []
        if deliverables:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._collect_deliverable_file_refs] count=%s | keys=%s",
                len(deliverables),
                list(deliverables[0].keys()) if deliverables else [],
            )
        return deliverables

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        """Store and display the message, then deliver to channels if toggle is on."""
        bot_text = self._input_to_text()
        message = await self._store_chat_message(bot_text)
        # Always deliver the agent's final text when channel delivery is on — including
        # owned HITL rejects. The reject resume path instructs the agent to emit a
        # rejection acknowledgment; suppressing delivery here left Teams with silence.
        if self.channel_delivery:
            await self._run_channel_delivery(bot_text)
        return message

    async def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,
        field_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Toggle channel delivery fields; auto-fetch routes; handle model provider UI."""
        if field_name == ChatOutput.ATTR_CHANNEL_DELIVERY:
            is_on = bool(field_value)
            for field in ChatOutput._CHANNEL_DELIVERY_FIELDS:
                if field in build_config:
                    build_config[field]["show"] = is_on
            self._set_llm_fields_visibility(build_config, is_on)
            if is_on:
                provider_name = build_config.get(
                    "model_provider", {}
                ).get("value", "")
                if provider_name:
                    build_config = await self.update_llm_build_config(
                        build_config,
                        str(provider_name),
                        "model_provider",
                    )
                await self._auto_populate_routes(build_config)
            return build_config

        if field_name in (
            "model_provider",
            LLMBasedComponent.MODEL_ID_FIELD,
            "region_name",
        ):
            build_config = await self.update_llm_build_config(
                build_config, str(field_value), field_name
            )

        if field_name == ChatOutput.ATTR_DELIVERY_TARGETS:
            await self._auto_populate_routes(build_config)

        if field_name in ("assumed_policy_id", "workspace_id"):
            await self._refresh_policy_options(build_config)

        return build_config

    async def _refresh_policy_options(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch and update Assume Policy dropdown options from workspace policies."""
        if not self.workspace_id:
            return
        orm_manager = get_orm_manager()
        try:
            async with orm_manager.with_session() as session:
                policies = await orm_manager.get_policies_by_workspace_id(
                    session, self.workspace_id
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            Main.logger().error(f"Failed to fetch workspace policies: {exc!s}")
            raise
        options = [""]
        metadata = [{"label": "None (use flow settings)", "icon": "x"}]
        for p in policies:
            options.append(str(p.id))
            metadata.append({"label": p.name, "icon": "shield"})
        if "assumed_policy_id" in build_config:
            build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options"] = options
            build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options_metadata"] = metadata

    @staticmethod
    def format_kb_option(kb_name: str, kb_type: str | KBProviderType | None) -> str:
        """Build a dropdown option as name#INHOUSE or name#BEDROCK (guardrail-style)."""
        if kb_type in (
            KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE,
            KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_INHOUSE,
        ):
            suffix = KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_INHOUSE
        elif kb_type in (
            KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK,
            KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_BEDROCK,
        ):
            suffix = KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_BEDROCK
        else:
            return kb_name
        return f"{kb_name}{KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SEPARATOR}{suffix}"

    @staticmethod
    def parse_kb_selection(selection: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
        """Split a KB selection into (bare_name, INHOUSE|BEDROCK|None)."""
        separator = KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SEPARATOR
        if separator not in selection:
            return selection, None
        bare_name, provider_suffix = selection.split(separator, 1)
        if provider_suffix in (
            KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_INHOUSE,
            KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_BEDROCK,
        ):
            return bare_name, provider_suffix
        return selection, None

    async def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,
        field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Dynamically populate knowledge_base_name dropdown when workspace_id is available.

        This method is called by the backend when a field value changes, during real_time_refresh,
        or when the refresh button is clicked.

        Always fetches fresh KB list to ensure newly created KBs are included.
        """

        workspace_id = self.workspace_id

        # Always fetch fresh KB list to ensure newly created KBs are included
        # Clear cache before fetching to guarantee fresh data
        self._kb_list_cache = None

        if workspace_id:
            user_id = str(self.graph.user_id) if self.graph and self.graph.user_id else None
            if user_id is None:
                raise ValueError("user_id is required to fetch knowledge bases but is not available")
            kb_list = await self._fetch_knowledge_bases_list_async(workspace_id, user_id=user_id)

            self._kb_list_cache = kb_list
            kb_names = [
                KnowledgeRetrievalComponent.format_kb_option(
                    kb.get("knowledge_base_name"),
                    kb.get("knowledge_base_type"),
                )
                for kb in kb_list
                if kb.get("knowledge_base_name")
            ]

            # Update build_config with new options
            if "knowledge_base_name" in build_config:
                build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["options"] = kb_names
                # Ensure value is always a list for MultiselectInput (handle migration from single select)
                current_value = build_config["knowledge_base_name"].get("value")
                if isinstance(current_value, str):
                    # Migrate from old single-select string to list
                    build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["value"] = [current_value] if current_value else []
                elif not isinstance(current_value, list):
                    # Handle any other non-list types
                    build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["value"] = []
            else:
                build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["options"] = []

            # Populate fallback KB dropdown with same options
            if "fallback_knowledge_base_name" in build_config:
                build_config["fallback_knowledge_base_name"]["options"] = [""] + kb_names

        return build_config

    def _execution_kb_scope(self) -> tuple[str | None, int | None]:
        """Resolve (user_id, policy_id) for the KB fetch from the flow execution setting.

        flow_owner / executing_user -> fetch by execution_user_id.
        custom_policy -> fetch by the selected policy_id.
        No compiled permission context -> fall back to the graph user.
        """
        default_user_id = str(self.graph.user_id) if self.graph and self.graph.user_id else None

        if not self.graph:
            return default_user_id, None

        perm_map = self.graph.ctx.state.resource_permissions or {}
        execution_role = perm_map.get("execution_role")
        execution_user_id = perm_map.get("execution_user_id")
        policy_id = perm_map.get("policy_id")

        if execution_role == AgentExecutionRole.CUSTOM_POLICY and policy_id:
            return None, int(policy_id)
        if execution_user_id:
            return str(execution_user_id), None
        return default_user_id, None

        self,
        workspace_id: str,
        user_id: str | None = None,

    def _get_kb_details_by_name(self, kb_name: str) -> dict:
        """Get KB details by selection (name or name#INHOUSE|BEDROCK) from cached list."""
        if not self._kb_list_cache:
            raise ValueError("KB list not cached")

        bare_name, provider_suffix = KnowledgeRetrievalComponent.parse_kb_selection(kb_name)
        expected_type: KBProviderType | None = None
        if provider_suffix == KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_INHOUSE:
            expected_type = KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE
        elif provider_suffix == KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._KB_OPTION_SUFFIX_BEDROCK:
            expected_type = KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK

        for kb in self._kb_list_cache:
            if kb.get("knowledge_base_name") != bare_name:
                continue
            if expected_type is not None and kb.get("knowledge_base_type") != expected_type:
                continue
            return kb

        raise ValueError(f"KB '{kb_name}' not found")

    def _get_kb_type_from_name(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Get KB type from name."""
        kb_details = self._get_kb_details_by_name(kb_name)
        return kb_details.get("knowledge_base_type")

    def _get_kb_id_from_name(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Get KB ID from selection (name or name#INHOUSE|BEDROCK)."""
        return self._get_kb_details_by_name(kb_name).get("knowledge_base_id")

    def _get_bedrock_storage_type(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Get the vector storage backend type from a Bedrock KB's storageConfiguration."""
        kb_details = self._get_kb_details_by_name(kb_name)
        storage_config = kb_details.get("storage_configuration")
        if storage_config and isinstance(storage_config, dict):
            return storage_config.get("type", self._STORAGE_TYPE_OPENSEARCH_CLUSTER)
        return self._STORAGE_TYPE_OPENSEARCH_CLUSTER

    def _get_bedrock_kb_id_on_destination(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Get the Bedrock-side KB ID (idOnDestination) for use with the Retrieve API."""
        kb_details = self._get_kb_details_by_name(kb_name)
        id_on_dest = kb_details.get("id_on_destination")
        if not id_on_dest:
            raise ValueError(f"Bedrock KB '{kb_name}' has no idOnDestination configured")
        return id_on_dest

    def _map_search_type_to_retrieve_api(self, search_type: str) -> str:
        """Map internal search type to Bedrock Retrieve API overrideSearchType."""
        if search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_HYBRID_SEARCH_TYPE:
            return self._RETRIEVE_SEARCH_TYPE_HYBRID
        return self._RETRIEVE_SEARCH_TYPE_SEMANTIC

    def _build_retrieve_api_filter(self, metadata_filters: dict[str, Any]) -> dict | None:
        """Convert flat metadata dict to Bedrock Retrieve API RetrievalFilter format.

        Converts {"department": "HR", "year": 2024} to:
        {"andAll": [{"equals": {"key": "department", "value": "HR"}},
                    {"equals": {"key": "year", "value": 2024}}]}
        """
        if not metadata_filters:
            return None

        filter_conditions = [
            {"equals": {"key": key, "value": value}}
            for key, value in metadata_filters.items()
        ]

        if len(filter_conditions) == 1:
            return filter_conditions[0]

        return {"andAll": filter_conditions}

    def _get_index_name_from_kb(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Extract index name from KB details, using stored config for backward compatibility."""
        kb_details = self._get_kb_details_by_name(kb_name)
        kb_type = kb_details.get("knowledge_base_type")

        # Try to read stored index name from config (covers legacy name-based indexes)
        if kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE:
            dest_config = kb_details.get("destination_knowledge_configuration")
            if dest_config and dest_config.get("name"):
                return dest_config["name"]
        elif kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:
            storage_config = kb_details.get("storage_configuration")
            if storage_config:
                os_config = storage_config.get("opensearch_managed_cluster_configuration", {})
                index_name = os_config.get("vector_index_name")
                if index_name:
                    return index_name

        # Default: id-based index name for new KBs
        kb_id = kb_details.get("knowledge_base_id")
        return f"{self.workspace_id}_{kb_id}"

        if kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:

    def _extract_model_id_from_arn(self, arn: str) -> str:
        """Extract model ID from AWS ARN.

        Example ARN: arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0
        Returns: amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0
        """
        if not arn:
            return None
        # ARN format: arn:aws:bedrock:region::foundation-model/model-id
        parts = arn.split("/")
        if len(parts) >= self._ARN_MIN_PARTS_FOR_MODEL_ID:
            return parts[-1]
        return None

    async def _get_embedding_model_id_from_kb(self, kb_name: str) -> str:
        """Get embedding model ID from knowledge base configuration."""
        kb_type = self._get_kb_type_from_name(kb_name)
        kb_id = self._get_kb_id_from_name(kb_name)

        if kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE:
            in_house_kb: InHouseKnowledgeBase = await self._get_in_house_kb_by_id(kb_id)
            return in_house_kb.parsingConfiguration.get("embedding_model_id")

        elif kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:
            bedrock_kb: BedrockKnowledgeBase = await self._get_bedrock_kb_by_id(kb_id)
            vector_config = bedrock_kb.kbConfig.get("vector_knowledge_base_configuration", {})
            embedding_model_arn = vector_config.get("embedding_model_arn")
            return self._extract_model_id_from_arn(embedding_model_arn)

        raise ValueError(f"Invalid KB type: {kb_type}")

    async def _get_opensearch_vector_field(self, kb_name: str) -> str:

        kb_type = self._get_kb_type_from_name(kb_name)

            raise ValueError(f"Invalid KB type: {kb_type}")

    @check_cached_vector_store
    @time_it
    async def build_vector_store(self, kb_name: str | None = None) -> OpenSearchVectorSearch:
        """Build OpenSearch vector store for a specific knowledge base.

        Args:
            kb_name: The name of the knowledge base to build vector store for. When
                omitted, the first effective (selected) knowledge base is used. This
                keeps compatibility with the inherited zero-argument
                ``build_vector_store`` / ``as_vector_store`` contract while still
                supporting per-KB construction for multi-KB search.

        Note: For multi-KB search, each KB will have its own vector store instance.
        """
        resolved_kb_name = kb_name or self._first_effective_kb_name()
        try:
            kb_type = self._get_kb_type_from_name(resolved_kb_name)
            env_config = self._get_opensearch_config_from_env(kb_type)
            vector_field = await self._get_opensearch_vector_field(resolved_kb_name)
            index_name = self._get_index_name_from_kb(resolved_kb_name)

            Main.logger().debug(f"[build_vector_store] Building vector store for KB '{resolved_kb_name}' with index '{index_name}'")

            # Build embedding using the same model that was used to create the KB
            embedding = await self.get_embedding(resolved_kb_name)

            opensearch_url = env_config.get("opensearch_url")
            username = env_config.get("username")
            password = env_config.get("password")

            if not password:
                raise ValueError("OpenSearch password not configured")

            opensearch = OpenSearchVectorSearch(
                index_name=index_name,
                embedding_function=embedding,
                opensearch_url=opensearch_url,
                http_auth=(username, password),
                use_ssl=self.use_ssl,
                verify_certs=self.verify_certs,
                ssl_assert_hostname=False,
                ssl_show_warn=False,
                vector_field=vector_field,
            )

            Main.logger().debug(f"[build_vector_store] Successfully built vector store for KB '{resolved_kb_name}'")
            return opensearch

        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"[build_vector_store] Failed to build vector store for KB '{resolved_kb_name}': {e}")
            raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to build vector store for '{resolved_kb_name}': {e}") from e

    def _first_effective_kb_name(self) -> str:
        """Return the first effective (selected) KB name for zero-argument callers."""
        effective_names = self._get_effective_kb_names()
        if not effective_names:
            raise ValueError("No knowledge bases selected")
        return effective_names[0]

    def _append_unavailable_kb_notice(self, retrieved_data: list[Data]) -> None:
        """Append a notice naming KBs this run could not search."""
        if not self._unpermitted_kb_names:
            return

        unavailable = ", ".join(f"'{name}'" for name in self._unpermitted_kb_names)
        retrieved_data.append(
            Data(
                file_path="",
                text=(
                    f"KNOWLEDGE_BASE_UNAVAILABLE: {unavailable} could not be searched "
                    f"because the current user has not been granted access. Do not retry. "
                    f"Answer from the knowledge bases that were searched, and tell the "
                    f"user which ones you could not consult."
                ),
            ),
        )

    def _get_effective_kb_names(self) -> list[str]:
        """Resolve each selected KB to primary/fallback, dropping denied ones."""
        self._unpermitted_kb_names = []

        raw = self.knowledge_base_name
        if isinstance(raw, str):
            original_names = [raw] if raw else []
        elif isinstance(raw, list):
            original_names = [n for n in raw if n]
        else:
            return []

        if not original_names:
            return []

        if not (hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph and hasattr(self.graph, "ctx")):
            return original_names

        node_id = getattr(self, "_id", None) or getattr(self, "vertex_id", None)
        if not node_id:
            return original_names

        reader = ResourcePermissionReader(self.graph.ctx.state.resource_permissions)

        effective: list[str] = []
        for name in original_names:
            resolved = reader.effective_kb_name(node_id, name)
            if resolved is None:
                Main.logger().info(f"KB '{name}' is not permitted for node {node_id}, skipping it")
                self._unpermitted_kb_names.append(name)
                continue

            if resolved != name:
                Main.logger().info(f"Using fallback KB '{resolved}' for node {node_id}, original '{name}'")
            effective.append(resolved)

        return effective
    @Main.telemetry_manager().workflow(name="knowledge_retrieval_search")
    @time_it
    async def search(self, query: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search for similar documents across multiple knowledge bases and aggregate results.

        This method searches across all selected knowledge bases using the same search parameters
        (top_k, search_type, score_threshold, etc.) and aggregates the results.
        """
        try:
            query = query or ""

            # Resolve effective KBs from permission map (primary or fallback per KB)
            kb_names = self._get_effective_kb_names()

            if not kb_names:
                if self._unpermitted_kb_names:
                    Main.logger().info(
                        f"[KB Multi-Search] No permitted knowledge base for this run; "
                        f"unavailable: {self._unpermitted_kb_names}",
                    )
                    self._complete_embedding_trace([])
                    return []
                raise ValueError("No knowledge bases selected")

            Main.logger().info(f"[KB Multi-Search] Searching across {len(kb_names)} KB(s): {kb_names} with top_k={self.top_k}")

            # Aggregate results from all selected knowledge bases
            all_results = []

            for idx, kb_name in enumerate(kb_names, 1):
                try:
                    Main.logger().info(f"[KB Multi-Search] ({idx}/{len(kb_names)}) Searching KB: '{kb_name}'")

                    self._cached_vector_store = None

                    search_kwargs = {"k": self.top_k}
                    index_name = self._get_index_name_from_kb(kb_name)
                    kb_type = self._get_kb_type_from_name(kb_name)

                    # Only build OpenSearch vector store for backends that need direct access
                    vector_store = None
                    if kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE:
                        vector_store = await self.build_vector_store(kb_name)
                    elif kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:
                        storage_type = self._get_bedrock_storage_type(kb_name)
                        if storage_type == self._STORAGE_TYPE_OPENSEARCH_CLUSTER:
                            vector_store = await self.build_vector_store(kb_name)

                    # Search in this KB
                    kb_results = await self._handle_different_kb_types_searching(
                        query, kb_type, vector_store, index_name, search_kwargs, kb_name
                    )
                    
                    # Track results per KB
                    num_results = len(kb_results)
                    avg_score = sum(r.get("score", 0) for r in kb_results if "score" in r) / num_results if num_results > 0 else 0
                    Main.logger().info(f"[KB Multi-Search] KB '{kb_name}': {num_results} results (avg_score={avg_score:.4f})")
                    
                    # Add KB name to metadata for tracking which KB each result came from
                    for result in kb_results:
                        if "metadata" not in result:
                            result["metadata"] = {}
                        result["metadata"]["knowledge_base_name"] = kb_name
                    
                    all_results.extend(kb_results)
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    Main.logger().error(f"[KB Multi-Search] ERROR in KB '{kb_name}': {e}")
                    continue
            
            # Sort all results by score (if available) across all KBs
            if all_results and "score" in all_results[0]:
                all_results.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("score", 0), reverse=True)
            
            # Return all aggregated results (top_k per KB, not limited globally)
            final_results = all_results
            
            # Log which KBs contributed to final results
            kb_distribution = {}
            for result in final_results:
                kb = result.get("metadata", {}).get("knowledge_base_name", "unknown")
                kb_distribution[kb] = kb_distribution.get(kb, 0) + 1
            
            Main.logger().info(f"[KB Multi-Search] Returning {len(final_results)} total results from {len(kb_names)} KB(s). Distribution: {kb_distribution}")
            
            self._complete_embedding_trace(final_results)
            
            return final_results

        except Exception as e:
            self._complete_embedding_trace([])
            error_message = f"Error during search: {e}"
            Main.logger().error(f"[KB Multi-Search] FATAL ERROR: {error_message}", exc_info=True)
            raise RuntimeError(error_message) from e

    @staticmethod
    def _complete_embedding_trace(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        try:
            from opentelemetry.instrumentation.bedrock import complete_embedding_span

            retrieved_texts = [r.get("page_content", "") for r in results]
            complete_embedding_span(retrieved_texts)
        except Exception:
            Main.logger().debug("[KB Trace] Could not attach retrieval output to embedding span")

    def _build_knn_query(
        self,
        kb_type: str,
        vector_field: str,
        query_vector: list[float],
        k_value: int,
        metadata_filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Build a generic KNN query for OpenSearch that works for any KB type."""

        knn_query = {
            vector_field: {
                "vector": query_vector,
                "k": k_value
            }
        }
        
        if metadata_filters:
            metadata_query = self._build_metadata_filter_query(metadata_filters)
            if metadata_query:
                knn_query[vector_field]["filter"] = {
                    "bool": {
                        "must": metadata_query["bool"]["must"]
                    }
                }
        
        return {
            "size": k_value,
            "query": {
                "knn": knn_query
            }
        }

    def _build_hybrid_query(
        self,
        kb_type: str,
        query_str: str,
        vector_field: str,
        query_vector: list[float],
        k_value: int,
        metadata_filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Build a hybrid query combining text matching with KNN search."""

        text_field = (
            self._DEFAULT_IN_HOUSE_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD
            if kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE
            else self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD
        )

        knn_clause = {
            vector_field: {
                "vector": query_vector,
                "k": k_value
            }
        }

        if metadata_filters:
            metadata_query = self._build_metadata_filter_query(metadata_filters)
            if metadata_query:
                knn_clause[vector_field]["filter"] = {
                    "bool": {
                        "must": metadata_query["bool"]["must"]
                    }
                }

        # Build hybrid query: combine text match with KNN in a bool should clause
        # Using "should" allows both to contribute to the score
        return {
            "size": k_value,
            "query": {
                "bool": {
                    "should": [
                        {"match": {text_field: query_str}},
                        {"knn": knn_clause}
                    ],
                    "minimum_should_match": KnowledgeRetrievalComponent._MINIMUM_SHOULD_MATCH_IN_HYBRID_SEARCH
                }
            }
        }

    def _build_search_query(
        self,
        kb_type: str,
        search_type: str,
        query_str: str,
        vector_field: str,
        query_vector: list[float],
        k_value: int,
        metadata_filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Orchestrator method that determines which query builder to use."""

        if search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_SIMILARITY_SEARCH_TYPE:
            return self._build_knn_query(kb_type, vector_field, query_vector, k_value, metadata_filters)
        elif search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_HYBRID_SEARCH_TYPE:
            return self._build_hybrid_query(kb_type, query_str, vector_field, query_vector, k_value, metadata_filters)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported search type: {search_type}")

    async def _search_via_retrieve_api(self, query: str, kb_name: str, search_kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search using the Bedrock Retrieve API (bedrock-agent-runtime).

        Used for Bedrock KBs with OpenSearch Serverless, Neptune Analytics,
        S3 Vectors, and Web Crawl storage backends.

        Args:
            query: Search query string
            kb_name: Name of the knowledge base being searched
            search_kwargs: Search parameters (expects 'k' for number of results)
        """
        bedrock_kb_id = self._get_bedrock_kb_id_on_destination(kb_name)
        region = _get_configuration().aws_configuration.aws_bedrock_region or "us-east-1"
        client = AWSUtilities.bedrock_agent_runtime_client(region_name=region)

        top_k = min(
            search_kwargs.get("k", self._OPENSEARCH_DEFAULT_NUMBER_OF_RESULTS),
            self._RETRIEVE_MAX_PAGE_SIZE,
        )

        search_type = self.search_type.lower().strip()
        override_search_type = self._map_search_type_to_retrieve_api(search_type)

        vector_search_config = {
            self._RETRIEVE_REQ_NUM_RESULTS_KEY: top_k,
            self._RETRIEVE_REQ_OVERRIDE_SEARCH_TYPE_KEY: override_search_type,
        }

        metadata_filters = self._parse_search_metadata(KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK)
        retrieve_filter = self._build_retrieve_api_filter(metadata_filters)
        if retrieve_filter:
            vector_search_config[self._RETRIEVE_REQ_FILTER_KEY] = retrieve_filter

        retrieve_kwargs = {
            self._RETRIEVE_REQ_KB_ID_KEY: bedrock_kb_id,
            self._RETRIEVE_REQ_QUERY_KEY: {
                self._RETRIEVE_REQ_QUERY_TEXT_KEY: query,
            },
            self._RETRIEVE_REQ_CONFIG_KEY: {
                self._RETRIEVE_REQ_VECTOR_SEARCH_KEY: vector_search_config,
            },
        }

        Main.logger().debug(f"[Retrieve API] Calling Bedrock Retrieve for KB '{kb_name}' (id={bedrock_kb_id})")

        try:
            response = client.retrieve(**retrieve_kwargs)
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Bedrock Retrieve API call failed for KB '{kb_name}': {e}") from e

        if self._RETRIEVE_RESULTS_KEY not in response:
            raise ValueError(f"Bedrock Retrieve API response missing '{self._RETRIEVE_RESULTS_KEY}' key")

        processed_results = []
        for result in response[self._RETRIEVE_RESULTS_KEY]:
            content = result.get(self._RETRIEVE_CONTENT_KEY, {})
            text = content.get(self._RETRIEVE_TEXT_KEY, "")

            metadata = result.get(self._RETRIEVE_METADATA_KEY, {})

            location = result.get(self._RETRIEVE_LOCATION_KEY, {})
            source_uri = self._extract_source_uri_from_location(location)
            if source_uri:
                metadata["source_uri"] = source_uri

            entry = {
                "page_content": text,
                "metadata": metadata,
            }
            score = result.get(self._RETRIEVE_SCORE_KEY)
            if score is not None:
                entry["score"] = score

            processed_results.append(entry)

        Main.logger().debug(f"[Retrieve API] KB '{kb_name}': {len(processed_results)} results")
        return processed_results

    @staticmethod
    def _extract_source_uri_from_location(location: dict) -> str:
        """Extract source URI from Bedrock Retrieve API location object."""
        if not location:
            return ""

        location_type = location.get("type", "")

        if location_type == "S3":
            s3_loc = location.get("s3Location", {})
            return s3_loc.get("uri", "")
        elif location_type == "WEB":
            web_loc = location.get("webLocation", {})
            return web_loc.get("url", "")
        elif location_type == "CONFLUENCE":
            return location.get("confluenceLocation", {}).get("url", "")
        elif location_type == "SHAREPOINT":
            return location.get("sharePointLocation", {}).get("url", "")
        elif location_type == "SALESFORCE":
            return location.get("salesforceLocation", {}).get("url", "")

        return ""

    async def _handle_different_kb_types_searching(self, query: str, kb_type: str, vector_store: OpenSearchVectorSearch | None, index_name: str, search_kwargs: dict, kb_name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Handle different knowledge base types searching.

        Routes to the appropriate search method based on KB type and storage backend.
        - IN_HOUSE: Direct OpenSearch query
        - AWS_BEDROCK + OpenSearch Managed Cluster: Direct OpenSearch query
        - AWS_BEDROCK + other backends (Serverless, Neptune, S3 Vectors, Web): Bedrock Retrieve API
        """
        if kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE:
            return await self._search_inhouse(query, vector_store, index_name, search_kwargs, kb_name)
        elif kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:
            storage_type = self._get_bedrock_storage_type(kb_name)
            if storage_type == self._STORAGE_TYPE_OPENSEARCH_CLUSTER:
                return await self._search_bedrock(query, vector_store, index_name, search_kwargs, kb_name)
            else:
                return await self._search_via_retrieve_api(query, kb_name, search_kwargs)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid knowledge base type: {kb_type}")

    def _parse_metadata_field(self, metadata: Any) -> dict:
        """Parse metadata field which might be a JSON string or dict"""
        if isinstance(metadata, str):
            try:
                return json.loads(metadata)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                return {}
        elif isinstance(metadata, dict):
            return metadata
        else:
            return {}

    def _parse_search_metadata(self, kb_type: str) -> dict[str, str | int | bool]:
        """Parse the search metadata JSON to filter the search results."""

        if not self.search_metadata:
            return {}

        try:
            metadata_dict = json.loads(self.search_metadata)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            error_message = f"Invalid search metadata JSON: {e}"
            raise ValueError(error_message) from e
        
        result_dict = {}
        if kb_type == KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK:
            for key, value in metadata_dict.items():
                if not isinstance(value, (str, int, bool)):
                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid type of value for metadata key '{key}': {type(value)}. Expected string, int, or bool.")
                result_dict[key] = value
        elif kb_type == KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE:
            for key, value in metadata_dict.items():
                if not isinstance(value, (str, int, bool)):
                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid type of value for metadata key '{key}': {type(value)}. Expected string, int, or bool.")
                result_dict[f"{self._IN_HOUSE_OPENSEARCH_METADATA_FIELD}.{key}"] = value
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid knowledge base type: {kb_type}")

        return result_dict
    


    async def _search_inhouse(self, query: str, vector_store: OpenSearchVectorSearch, index_name: str, search_kwargs: dict[str, Any], kb_name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search method specific to In-House knowledge base.
        
        Args:
            query: Search query string
            vector_store: OpenSearch vector store instance
            index_name: Name of the index to search
            search_kwargs: Search parameters
            kb_name: Name of the knowledge base being searched
        """

        vector_field = await self._get_opensearch_vector_field(kb_name)

        embedding = await self.get_embedding(kb_name)
        query_vector = embedding.embed_query(query)
        metadata_filters = self._parse_search_metadata(KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE)
        k_value = search_kwargs.get("k", self._OPENSEARCH_DEFAULT_NUMBER_OF_RESULTS)
        search_type = self.search_type.lower().strip()

        query_str = query.strip()
        if not query_str and getattr(self, "search_query", None):
            if hasattr(self.search_query, "text"):
                query_str = str(self.search_query.text).strip()
            else:
                query_str = str(self.search_query).strip()

        needs_custom_search = metadata_filters or search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_HYBRID_SEARCH_TYPE
        
        if needs_custom_search:
            search_body = self._build_search_query(
                kb_type=KBProviderType.IN_HOUSE,
                search_type=search_type,
                query_str=query_str,
                vector_field=vector_field,
                query_vector=query_vector,
                k_value=k_value,
                metadata_filters=metadata_filters,
            )

            results = vector_store.client.search(index=index_name, body=search_body)
            
            processed_results = []
            for idx, hit in enumerate(results.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])):
                source = hit.get("_source", {})
                text = source.get(self._DEFAULT_IN_HOUSE_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD, "")
                metadata = self._parse_metadata_field(
                    source.get(self._DEFAULT_IN_HOUSE_OPENSEARCH_METADATA_FIELD, {})
                )

                if isinstance(text, dict):
                    text = text.get(self._DEFAULT_IN_HOUSE_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD, "")

                result = {
                    "page_content": text,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                }
                if "_score" in hit:
                    result["score"] = hit["_score"]

                processed_results.append(result)
            
            return processed_results

        results = self._search_without_metadata_filters(query, vector_store, vector_field, search_kwargs)
        return results

    async def _search_bedrock(self, query: str, vector_store: OpenSearchVectorSearch, index_name: str, search_kwargs: dict[str, Any], kb_name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search method specific to Bedrock knowledge base.

        Args:
            query: Search query string
            vector_store: OpenSearch vector store instance
            index_name: Name of the index to search
            search_kwargs: Search parameters
            kb_name: Name of the knowledge base being searched
        """
        embedding = await self.get_embedding(kb_name)
        query_vector = embedding.embed_query(query)
        vector_field = self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_VECTOR_FIELD
        metadata_filters = self._parse_search_metadata(KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK)
        k_value = search_kwargs.get("k", self._OPENSEARCH_DEFAULT_NUMBER_OF_RESULTS)
        search_type = self.search_type.lower().strip()
        
        query_str = query.strip()
        if not query_str and getattr(self, "search_query", None):
            if hasattr(self.search_query, "text"):
                query_str = str(self.search_query.text).strip()
            else:
                query_str = str(self.search_query).strip()
        
        search_body = self._build_search_query(
            kb_type=KBProviderType.AWS_BEDROCK,
            search_type=search_type,
            query_str=query_str,
            vector_field=vector_field,
            query_vector=query_vector,
            k_value=k_value,
            metadata_filters=metadata_filters,
        )

        results = vector_store.client.search(index=index_name, body=search_body)
        
        processed_results = []
        for idx, hit in enumerate(results.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])):
            source = hit.get("_source", {})
            text = source.get(self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD, "")

            if isinstance(text, dict):
                text = text.get(self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD, "")

            # For Bedrock: metadata fields are stored independently in _source, not nested in "metadata" field
            metadata = {}
            metadata_text = source.get(self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_METADATA_FIELD, "")
            if metadata_text:
                parsed_metadata = self._parse_metadata_field(metadata_text)
                if isinstance(parsed_metadata, dict):
                    metadata.update(parsed_metadata)
            
            # Add all other fields from source as metadata (department, doc_id, filename, etc.)
            excluded_fields = {
                self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_VECTOR_FIELD,
                self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_TEXT_FIELD,
                self._DEFAULT_AWS_BEDROCK_OPENSEARCH_METADATA_FIELD,
            }
            for key, value in source.items():
                if key not in excluded_fields:
                    metadata[key] = value

            # Include score if available
            result = {
                "page_content": text,
                "metadata": metadata,
            }
            if "_score" in hit:
                result["score"] = hit["_score"]

            processed_results.append(result)
        
        return processed_results

    def _search_without_metadata_filters(self, query: str, vector_store: OpenSearchVectorSearch, vector_field: str, search_kwargs: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search method without metadata filters."""

        search_type = self.search_type.lower()
        search_kwargs["vector_field"] = vector_field

        if search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_SIMILARITY_SEARCH_TYPE:
            results = vector_store.similarity_search(query, **search_kwargs)
            return [{"page_content": doc.page_content, "metadata": self._parse_metadata_field(doc.metadata)} for doc in results]
        else:
            results = vector_store.similarity_search(query, **search_kwargs)
            return [{"page_content": doc.page_content, "metadata": self._parse_metadata_field(doc.metadata)} for doc in results]


    def search_documents(self) -> List[Data]:
        """Search for documents across multiple knowledge bases and aggregate results."""
        try:
            # Handle both list and single string for backward compatibility
            kb_names = self.knowledge_base_name
            if isinstance(kb_names, str):
                kb_names = [kb_names] if kb_names else []
            elif not isinstance(kb_names, list):
                kb_names = []
                
            if not kb_names:
                # Return empty result with message instead of raising error
                Main.logger().info("[search_documents] No knowledge bases selected, returning empty result")
                empty_result = [Data(text="No knowledge bases selected")]
                self.status = empty_result
                return empty_result

            Main.logger().info(f"[search_documents] Initiated with {len(kb_names)} KB(s): {kb_names}")

            search_type = (self.search_type or "").lower().strip()

            is_hybrid_search = search_type == self._OPENSEARCH_HYBRID_SEARCH_TYPE

            query = ""
            if getattr(self, "search_query", None) is not None:
                if hasattr(self.search_query, "text"):
                    query = str(self.search_query.text or "").strip()
                else:
                    query = str(self.search_query or "").strip()

            if not query:
                if is_hybrid_search:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Search query is required for hybrid search (no query text received by component)"
                    )
                raise ValueError("Search query is required")

            Main.logger().info(f"[search_documents] Query: '{query[:100]}...', search_type: {search_type}")

            workspace_id = getattr(self, 'workspace_id', None)
            if not workspace_id:
                raise ValueError("Workspace ID is required")

            try:
                kb_list = asyncio.run(self._fetch_knowledge_bases_for_execution(workspace_id))
                self._kb_list_cache = kb_list
                Main.logger().debug(f"[search_documents] Fetched {len(kb_list)} execution-scoped KBs from workspace")
            except Exception as e:
                raise ValueError(f"Failed to fetch knowledge bases: {e}") from e

            # Execute search across all selected KBs
            results = asyncio.run(self.search(query))
            Main.logger().info(f"[search_documents] Search returned {len(results)} results before filtering")

            # Filter by threshold
            filtered_results = []
            for result in results:
                if "score" in result:
                    if result["score"] >= self.search_score_threshold:
                        filtered_results.append(result)
                else:
                    filtered_results.append(result)

            Main.logger().info(f"[search_documents] After score threshold filter ({self.search_score_threshold}): {len(filtered_results)} results")

            # Convert to Data objects
            retrieved_data = [
                Data(
                    file_path=result["metadata"].get("file_path", ""),
                    text=result["page_content"],
                )
                for result in filtered_results
            ]

            self._append_unavailable_kb_notice(retrieved_data)

            Main.logger().info(f"[search_documents] Returning {len(retrieved_data)} Data objects")
            self.status = retrieved_data
            return retrieved_data

        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"[search_documents] ERROR: {e}", exc_info=True)
            raise RuntimeError(f"Error during search: {e}") from e

    def as_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Return search results as a DataFrame."""
        return DataFrame(self.search_documents())

    def _extract_key_value(self, key_name: str) -> Message:
        """Extracts a specific key value from structured data."""
        structured_data = getattr(self, "_last_structured_data", [])
        if not structured_data:
            return Message(
                text=f"No structured data available for key '{key_name}'",
            )
        key_values = [
            item.get(key_name)
            for item in structured_data
            if isinstance(item, dict) and key_name in item
        ]
        if not key_values:
            return Message(
                text=f"Field '{key_name}' not found in structured output",
                sender_name=self.display_name,
            )
        if len(key_values) == 1:
            return Message(
                text=str(key_values[0]),
                data={key_name: key_values[0]},
            )
        combined_text = ", ".join(
            str(value) for value in key_values if value is not None
        )
        return Message(
            text=combined_text,
            data={key_name: key_values},
        )
